biggest_catch: Same-day check is real, but only after you drive the car to the dealer and it passes inspection - and the certified offer has a seven-day, 500-mile fuse.
catches: The inspection can change the certified offer if condition differs from your description.
The offer expires after seven days or 500 miles, whichever comes first.
You must visit a dealership in person with the vehicle and title documents.
Payment is by check - deposit/clearing time is extra.
Resale catch-all: value varies by condition and demand; quotes and market prices can change; fees or shipping can reduce your actual proceeds.

timing: Certified offer in ~30 minutes, valid seven days/500 miles; same-day check after inspection.
who_pays: AutoNation - the dealership pays you directly for your vehicle.
who_qualifies: You must own the vehicle (have the title), have valid ID, and bring the car in for in-person inspection.
work_available: Yes - AutoNation was buying vehicles as of 2026-09-23. You get a certified offer in about 30 minutes, but it dies after seven days or 500 miles.
what_gets_accepted: The in-person inspection decides the final number - the certified offer changes if the car's condition differs from your description.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees are stated in the verified evidence. Your unpaid time is entering details online and driving to the dealership for inspection.
when_cash_arrives: Real money by same-day check after the vehicle passes inspection - deposit and clearing time is extra on top of that.
